items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Yes. He had been to school. The rest of them boys just picked it up.

ctx.x: Yes. Some of them had. Now, Willie Lewis and Walter Page had been to school, and I think Coleman (that's the one we called Buckets), he was the first bandleader....
Yes. He had been to school. The rest of them boys just picked it up.
